scope: New Exeter source-relative validation after the original 20-site method was frozen. Two 65x65 original Float32 windows selected solely by raster dimensions (centre and north quarter); full 4096 m2 per window. The coarse city preview has been observed, but no full fitting outcomes for these windows have been measured before this protocol. This is not a fully blinded study or independent surveyed ground truth. Original twenty-site reports and all published kernels remain unchanged.
